activity_statements.statement: operates 500+ casual dining steakhouse restaurants serving fresh, never-frozen steaks grilled to order across the United States
operates as a subsidiary of Darden Restaurants since 2007, sharing corporate infrastructure, supply chain, and HR systems
has donated nearly 28 million pounds of fresh food to community food banks since 2008
trains kitchen staff to grill steaks to precise temperature specifications without shortcuts or pre-cooking

name_reality_gap: none — LongHorn Steakhouse is a steakhouse chain and the name accurately describes the business. As a Darden subsidiary, its back-office, supply chain, and corporate functions are shared with Olive Garden, Yard House, and other Darden brands.
extraction_notes: About page was informative. LongHorn is a Darden subsidiary; standalone 10-K not available. Exact location count (500+) taken from about page.
